proposals.proposal: The exact R8 witness demonstrates persisted candidate SimulationResult readability after an independent later failure, sibling/dependent lifecycle behavior, fresh reference reads, and CAS corruption refusal.
limitations: The test stops the embedded worker after ordinary POST admission, then runs a custom sibling-failure DAG manually through low-level WorkflowExecutor and explicitly attaches the admitted control_job_id to the run manifest. It does not prove ordinary worker dispatch of this request/DAG.
The debug route is candidate-reference-only and non-authority. Numeric Metrics content was verified in CAS; it is not rendered in the HTTP body.
Fixture identity, synthetic tenant/cell, unscoped artifacts and disabled security middleware do not establish production workload, active profile, custody, currentness or external authority.
